sentences.en: It is impossible for you to jump two meters high.
sentences.zh: 你跳两米高是不可能的。

sentences.en: Rhyme and meter form the essential rules of Chinese poetry.
sentences.zh: 押韵和格律构成了中国诗歌的基本规则。

sentences.en: He, being slow-footed, was of course already lagging two meters.
sentences.zh: 他因为走得慢，当然已经落后了两米。

senses.zh: 米；仪表；[计量] 公尺；韵律
